statements.notes:
MTS Nutrition Creapure Creatine uses only the finest German creatine. German-made creatine monohydrate is the highest quality creatine on the market, and has been manufactured since the mid-1990s. It is known and respected around the world for its unparalleled purity.
Manufactured by AlzChem Trostberg GmbH, Creapure is the only creatine produced in Germany. The raw materials that go into Creapure are carefully selected. Creatine is synthesized into Creapure using a patented production system and superior technology.
MTS Nutrition Creapure is exclusively manufactured by chemical synthesis to ensure optimal quality and purity.

statements.type: Precautions re: Pregnant or Nursing or Prescription Medications
statements.notes: Do not use if you are pregnant or nursing. Consult your physician prior to use if you are using any medications and/or have any medical conditions.

Warning: Consuming this product can expose you to chemicals which are known to the State of California to cause birth defects or other reproductive harm. For more information go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov

Directions for use: Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water or juice. For best results, drink immediately after your workout.
Loading phase: Days 1 through 5: Consume one scoop, four times daily. Space servings evenly throughout the day.
Maintenance Phase: Days 6 and beyond: Consume one scoop, one or two times daily.
